hide: Hide the guide for this page
demoNote: In the demo, remembered choices and entries last only until you reload or leave.
overview_1: The overview summarizes your saved check-ins for the selected period. Days without a check-in stay unknown; they are never counted as zero or as rest.
overview_2: Start with Daily check-in. Charts and summaries fill in as you save more days.
overview_3: Use the menu for Journal (past days), Trends & predictions (analysis) and Export & import (your files).
checkIn_1: Fields chosen in “Customize my check-in” are saved to your account immediately. The next day opens with the same set of fields — nothing resets overnight.
checkIn_2: Activities and habits you add stay in your routine and appear on following days with blank values. To stop repeating one, untick “Include on new days” or remove its row.
checkIn_3: After you remove an activity, it no longer appears automatically. To track it again, search for it in “Find an activity” and add it once more; custom activities can be restored in “Manage custom activities”.
checkIn_4: Only the layout is remembered. Measurements are never copied between days: every day starts blank, blank means not recorded, and nothing is stored until you press Save check-in.
checkIn_5: Hiding a field never deletes data. A field that already has a value on this day stays visible, and you can turn any field back on in “Customize my check-in”. Recently used options move to the top of lists.
journal_1: The journal lists saved days, newest first. Click a date to open the complete entry and correct it in the check-in form.
journal_2: Search and filters narrow the list; “Clear filters” shows every day again. Filters do not change any data.
journal_3: A missing date means no check-in was saved. It is not interpreted as a rest day or a day without symptoms.
analysis_1: Choose a view at the top: a single-metric trend, relationships between measures, a multivariable model, or definitions and methods.
analysis_2: Analyses use only saved numerical observations. Missing values are left out, never filled in, so results depend on how many days you have recorded.
analysis_3: Results are exploratory personal patterns with stated uncertainty. They are not causal, clinical or validated forecasts.
analysis_4: Metrics and inputs you pick are remembered in your account, so recently used choices appear first next time.
data_title: Export or import on one page
data_1: Use the two options at the top to switch between Export (download a copy) and Import (bring a file into your journal).
data_2: For a complete backup, use “Select complete JSON backup”. Written notes are included only when you select them. Markdown is a readable report and cannot be imported back.
data_3: Import reads JSON, NDJSON or CSV in your browser (up to 500 days and 20 MiB per file) and shows a preview. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
data_4: Choose how existing days are handled: skip them, or merge only the fields supplied in the file. Fields missing from the file stay unchanged.
